sloka: अतिबलसदृशैः पराक्रमैस्तैर्मम कुलमानविवर्धनं कृतम् ।यदयमतुल्यबलस्त्वयाद्य वै त्रिदशपतिस्त्रिदशाश्च निर्जिताः ।। ७.२९.४० ॥
transliteration: atibalasadṛśaiḥ parākramaistairmama kulamānavivardhanaṁ kṛtam ।yadayamatulyabalastvayādya vai tridaśapatistridaśāśca nirjitāḥ ।। 7.29.40 ॥

translations.english: By those exceedingly mighty valorous deeds, my family's honor has been greatly enhanced, for today, this Indra of incomparable strength and the other gods have indeed been conquered by you.
